item: CI: a documentation-only pull request runs a 15-minute fast path; macOS and Windows portability run weekly in three shards
summary: A changes job reads the PR diff (HEAD^1..HEAD of the merge commit) and says docs_only only when every path is docs/, root Markdown or a GitHub template; it fails open on any error, a push to main, the weekly run, dispatch and the ci-full label. docs-checks (planned-work index, ledger check, i18n, every test naming docs/CLAUDE.md/ledger) replaces the heavy jobs; test and Core-only aggregators accept it, other gated jobs report skipped. Portability: the macOS leg ran the whole suite in one process and was cancelled by its 45 min cap on every push (run 42377447182: pytest 13:43 to 14:27), holding a macOS runner for nothing; it now runs weekly and on dispatch in the same three shards as Linux, 60 min cap, Windows included. Three shards, not four: the cost table is for N=3 and tests pin it. Unmeasured: the fast path's wall time (estimate 10 to 15 min) and the macOS shard times (cap 60).
